title: Weekly Life Retrospective
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=lifeos:score OR sourcetype=quest:task OR sourcetype=achievement:life)
| where _time>relative_time(now(),"-7d@d")
| stats avg(score) as avg_score, sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as quests_done, sum(xp) as xp_earned
description: Produces a weekly retrospective — average life score, quests done, XP earned — like a sprint review for yourself.
value: A regular retro builds the habit of reflection and steady adjustment that makes real change stick.
implementation: Combine life feeds in `index=personal`; summarise the past week for a personal retro.
visualization: Weekly summary panel of score, quests, and XP.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you a weekly review of how life went — your score, tasks done, and points earned — to learn and adjust.
